name: replace_slot_values_with_calls
description: Stores constants into three base-relative longwords after passing their previous values to pointer-table calls, then clears another slot and makes further table calls.

name: replace_slot_values_with_calls
description: Stores a constant into two base-relative longwords after passing earlier values to pointer-table calls, then makes further table calls and clears another slot.

name: replace_slot_and_sequence_calls
description: Stores a constant into one base-relative longword, then runs a sequence of pointer-table calls that clear a slot and store the constants one and two into others.

name: set_slot_values_one_two
description: Stores the constants one and two into two base-relative longwords, with pointer-table calls between the stores, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: set_word_params_and_call
description: Stores fixed word values into base-relative slots, passes the first slot value and its neighbours to pointer-table calls, and reads a word back for a further call.

name: set_word_params_and_call
description: Stores fixed word values into base-relative slots, passes slot values to pointer-table calls, and reads a word back for a further call.

name: set_word_params_and_call
description: Stores fixed word values into base-relative slots, passes slot values to pointer-table calls, and reads a word back for a further call. The routine has 13 instructions.

name: clear_word_slot_after_call
description: Passes a word slot to a table call, stores the constant twenty-one into the frame, then clears the same word slot and makes a further table call with it.

name: clear_word_slot_and_call
description: Clears a base-relative word slot, makes one table call with it, then stores the returned word into a longword slot.

name: init_word_slots_and_call
description: Clears a base-relative word slot, passes slot values and constants to table calls, and stores results into further word slots. The routine has 51 instructions and calls two unnamed routines.

name: set_word_slot_to_two
description: Stores the constant two into a base-relative word slot and returns. It makes no call.

name: loop_until_flag_set
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and passes word slots to table calls until a base-relative flag word equals one. It then stores two into another word slot and returns.

name: set_word_slot_to_two
description: Stores the constant two into a base-relative word slot and returns. It makes no call.

name: loop_word_slot_table_calls
description: Loops over pointer-table calls that pass a base-relative word slot and a longword slot, adjusting the word slot according to a returned value.

name: decrement_word_slot_loop
description: Decrements a base-relative word slot in an outer loop and makes pointer-table calls with it and a longword slot in an inner loop.

name: increment_word_slot_loop
description: Increments a base-relative word slot in an outer loop and makes pointer-table calls with it and a longword slot in an inner loop.

name: set_word_slot_to_two
description: Stores the constant two into a base-relative word slot and returns. It makes no call.

name: loop_word_slot_pair_calls
description: Loops over pointer-table calls that pass a base-relative word slot with a longword slot, adjusting the word slot after each pass.

name: decrement_word_slot_loop
description: Decrements a base-relative word slot in an outer loop and makes pointer-table calls with it and a longword slot in an inner loop.

name: increment_word_slot_loop
description: Increments a base-relative word slot in an outer loop and makes pointer-table calls with it and a longword slot in an inner loop.

name: set_word_slot_to_two
description: Stores the constant two into a base-relative word slot and returns. It makes no call.

name: loop_pass_slot_pairs_calls
description: Loops over pointer-table calls that pass a longword slot with a word slot, and a second longword slot with another word slot, adjusting the word slots between passes.

name: set_word_slot_to_one
description: Stores the constant one into a base-relative word slot and returns. It makes no call.

name: loop_until_flag_set
description: Repeatedly calls an unnamed routine and passes word slots to table calls until a base-relative flag word equals one. It then stores two into another word slot and returns.

name: return_immediately
description: The decompiled body is a bare return with no other operations. The routine is two instructions long and called five times.

name: process_word_slots_with_calls
description: Copies two base-relative word slots, passes them with the constant seven to table calls, reads a longword slot and stores a result word. The routine has 43 instructions and calls two unnamed routines.

name: set_flag_word_to_one
description: Stores the constant one into a base-relative flag word and returns. It makes no call.

name: clear_flag_word
description: Stores zero into a base-relative flag word and returns. It makes no call.

name: loop_table_calls_with_flags
description: Clears two base-relative longwords, then loops over pointer-table calls that pass slot values and fixed constants, storing words into the frame. The routine has 26 instructions.

name: pass_slot_then_set_flag
description: Copies a base-relative longword into the frame, makes one pointer-table call with it, then sets a flag longword to a constant.

name: loop_select_slot_value
description: Runs a do-while loop of pointer-table calls. Each pass copies base-relative slots into the frame and selects between two slot values according to a word returned by a call.

name: loop_nested_slot_calls
description: Runs a loop that copies base-relative slots into the frame and makes pointer-table calls with those values, with an inner loop that stores a longword slot each pass.
